name: school
summary: Core school management: academic years, classes, sections, students, and fee categories
description: Foundation for the School Student Payment Management system. Defines the academic structure (academic years, classes/grades, sections), student enrollments with guardian details and teacher-child flag, and income fee categories. Establishes role-based access (Data Entry Clerk, Cashier, Manager/Director). Payments, fee structures, penalties, discounts, promotion and reporting are layered by companion modules.
author: Nexa
